description: If n is a prime power p^k with k at least 1, return that prime and the exponent. Otherwise the prime and the exponent are 0. 8 is 2^3, 49 is 7^2, and 12 is not a prime power. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-power
